title: nutty gooey slovakian kabocha tagine
description: a unique and exotic tagine dish featuring kabocha squash, nuts, and a mediterranean twist. perfect for a special date-night dinner.
instructions: cut the kabocha squash in half and scoop out the seeds.
in a large bowl, whisk together almond butter, honey, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
add the chopped walnuts to the bowl and stir until well combined.
place the kabocha squash halves in a baking dish and brush with olive oil.
pour the almond butter mixture over the squash and drizzle with water.
cover the dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the squash is tender.
while the squash is baking, rehydrate the dried dates by soaking them in water for 10-15 minutes.
once the squash is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
serve the squash with the rehydrated dates on top and drizzled with the pan juices.
